title: Chapter 417 Red-Eyed Shura'S Combat Power Explodes
content:
Chapter 417 Red-Eyed Shura'S Combat Power Explodes

[ID: SAC5678 Wang Shuo]

[Level: Level 83]

[Strength: 3284 (224+3000+60)]

[Constitution: 3288 (228+3000+60)]

[Agility: 2204 (144+2000+60)]

[Energy: 2185 (125+2000+60)]

[Life skills: 1. Smoothing mud (level 4), 2. Making mud pits (level 3)]

[Combat attribute panel]

[Attack power: 41180 (32840+10000+300)]

[Defense power: 7860]

【Commander value: 1256】

【Reputation value: 6150】

【Health value: 41180】

【Internal force value: 8000】

【Skills: "Dragon Spear Art" (5th level), "Black Dragon Sutra" (6th level)】

【Combat skills: 1. Summon mud puppet, 2. Eye of delusion, 3. Iron chain binding, 4. Double transformation, 5. Swamp trap, 6. Wind step, 7. Dragon attack, 8. Dragon out of the sea, 9. Flying dragon in the sky, 10. Shura Slash, 11. Absolute defense, 12. Speed up】

【Equipment: 1. Shura Demon Spear, epic equipment, can be upgraded to legendary level with upgrade gems. Strength +1000, Constitution +3000, Attack power +10000, additional skill, Shura Slash, each time you kill an enemy, you will gain Shura rage. When enough rage is accumulated, you can release Shura Slash to cause a lot of damage to the enemy. ]

[Equipment: 2, Shura Helmet: Epic equipment, Defense +2000, Energy +2000, Strength +2000, Agility +2000. Additional skills: The more you fight, the stronger you become: In the Red Eye state, continuous fighting will increase the upper limit of each attribute, up to 1 times. ]

[Equipment: 3, Shura Armor: Epic equipment, Defense +2500, Command +1000, Additional skills, 1. Block critical hits, passive skills, 2. Absolute defense, immune to all attacks, lasts 10 minutes, CD: 24 hours. ]

[Equipment: 4, Shura Leg Armor: Epic equipment, Health +10000, Internal Force +5000, Defense +3000, Additional skills: On protracted battle: In the Red Eye state, the attacks you cause will restore yourself (including physical strength, life, mental strength, etc.), and you will be more and more excited the more you kill. ]

[Equipment: 5, Shura Boots: Epic equipment, Agility +2000, with additional skills: Speed: In the Red Eye state, your agility value will gradually increase, and the current agility will be doubled. ]

(This equipment is exclusive to the Red Eye Shura. Unless in special circumstances, the equipment cannot be damaged or transferred to others for use.)

Wang Shuo felt the changes in himself.

For a moment, he didn't know what to say.

This is the horror of the title Shura? ! !

This is why a master has to come to make friends in person?

This is the qualification to become the top powerhouse on the continent?

Wang Shuo originally thought that the Shura suit was just a set of equipment.

But now it seems that this is not a set of equipment, it is clearly a set of artifacts.

Moreover, the quality of each piece of equipment can be improved.

Wang Shuo dared not imagine what it would be like after the upgrade to legendary quality.

Just when Wang Shuo was stunned and felt invincible.

Master Tongchui said leisurely: "Do you feel that you are invincible?"

Wang Shuo woke up instantly.

"I dare not!"

Wang Shuo was quite low-key, knowing that there are always people who are better than you, and he did not dare to act rashly in front of an old master.

"To tell you the truth, the strength of Shura generals is not only reflected in personal combat power. If you only rely on your current strength, you can barely dominate the entire continent."

"But if you want to go to the Central Dynasty, it's not enough."

"Imagine what the scene would be if you had 10 Shura generals under your command?"

"In addition, there are many non-Shura generals who also have the strength of the strongest king."

"This continent is far from as simple as you think."
